properties.title: SERVIR West Africa 2024 Training Program on Data Stewardship and the CoreTrustSeal Requirements: Session 3, R01 Requirement
properties.description: Pursuing CoreTrustSeal Certification offers various benefits for data repositories, including an opportunity to continually improve the quality of the data products and services offered to the designated community. After reviewing topics that have been discussed previously during the series, the third session in the 2024 SERVIR West Africa Training Program on Data Stewardship and the CoreTrustSeal Requirements reviews the R0 Context Requirement, discusses the R01 Mission and Scope Requirement along with examples, and introduces the R02 Rights Management Requirement.
